responsibility: This file implements expansion of primitive arithmetic, comparison, conversion, vector, atomic, and conditional operations through the optabs framework. It chooses between direct target patterns, widened forms, synthesized instruction sequences, and libcalls; adds semantic REG_EQUAL notes; legitimizes operands against instruction predicates; emits or builds insns via generic expand_operand descriptions; and serves as the main execution engine that turns optab selections into concrete RTL.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable expansion engine within the optabs stem: it turns optab choices into emitted RTL, libcalls, and synthesized instruction sequences. Unlike gcc/optabs.h, which exposes the API, and gcc/optabs.def, which declaratively lists available optabs and pattern names, this file performs the actual expansion work.
